free_tier.stated: Japanese incumbent GPU VM with an hourly, daily and monthly ladder in JPY, converted at USD 1 = JPY 157.05. NVIDIA H100 80GB: JPY 990 per hour, USD 6.30; JPY 23,100 per day, USD 147.09; JPY 385,000 per month, USD 2,451.45. NVIDIA V100 16GB: JPY 481 per hour, USD 3.06; JPY 11,550 per day, USD 73.54; JPY 231,000 per month, USD 1,470.87. The daily rate applies after 24 hours of continuous use and the monthly rate applies after 17 days for H100 and 20 days for V100, which caps the cost of a long run. The V100 plan is withdrawn on 2027-03-31.
free_tier.notes: The listed prices are tax-inclusive and fractions of a yen are truncated. The page lists no A100, L40S, L4 or RTX4090 plan.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: The monthly cap makes a continuous H100 USD 3.36 per hour, which is still above the USD 3.29 market median, so the composition worth noting is the opposite one: the daily cap makes a 24-hour benchmark cost USD 147 rather than USD 151 as an hourly sum.
limits_note: No published cap binds; the constraint is that the rate is roughly 3.5 times the H100 market median, so price rather than quota is what stops this.
